user_text: Perfect, that's done. Wow, it's really late.
text:
It's been a marathon session! You've built out an impressive genetics unit: learning goals, rubrics, exemplars, feedback CSVs, two full lesson plans with slide decks, student worksheets, lab handouts, safety materials in two languages, formative assessments, Punnett square practice sets, and answer keys. That's a lot of classroom-ready material.

When you're fresh, you might want to tackle Lesson 3 (mutations and gene expression) and the three performance assessments. Everything is scaffolded and ready to build on. Have a good rest!
